title: Dispatch: derive real audited membership and specific invariants (attempt 5)
description:
Supervisor fresh full review of f0e367c found a NEW DEFECT CLASS: the durable
model is structurally correct but its CONTENT is synthesized. Per the churn stop
rule this is the ONE permitted contract update and correction round. If the next
fresh full review finds another new defect class, PR #476 gets decomposed rather
than patched again.

=== KEEP — do not rebuild ===
The row model is right and reviewed: obligation + target + invariant (durable)
separated from violation (transient), baselineMembership distinct from generated
current membership, 68 rows, 70 aliases resolving, indep:011 accepted, the
indep:001 / sol:CAP-001 split, duplicate-canonicalId rejection. Keep all of it
and its tests. This round replaces synthesized CONTENT, not structure.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/finding-registry.md
  packages/core/src/rules/findingRegistry.ts
  packages/core/test/findingRegistry.test.ts

=== DEFECT 1: baselineMembership IS EXEMPLAR DATA, NOT AUDITED MEMBERSHIP ===
59 of 68 rows carry exactly ONE member; 7 carry two; 2 carry three.
  * half-damage-branches IS opus:F-25, whose own title reads '79 creature + 8
    hazard half-damage branches omitted'. Its baseline has 2 members.
  * rule-corpus-procedures IS sol:CAP-001, the 335-record rule corpus. 1 member.
  * spell-completeness spans 319 spells. 1 member.
A single exemplar cannot detect a defect that recurs anywhere else in the
population, which is the registry's entire purpose at eshyra-o9bd.19.6.4.

REQUIRED: derive baselineMembership by GENERATING it against the committed pack
at packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json, reconciled
with the finding's own stated scope in
/mnt/d/eshyra-2026-07-24-audit-repair-bead-plan.md. Records use the `key`
field, not `id`; executionReadiness is at record.data.executionReadiness and
exists on MAGIC-ITEM RECORDS ONLY.

Where a finding's true population is large, enumerate it fully — a generated
snapshot of identities is not a hand-copied count and does not violate count
hygiene. Where the population genuinely cannot be derived yet (for example it
needs the clause IR from PR #475), the row must say so EXPLICITLY with a defined
follow-up and a status the validator recognises — it must NOT carry an exemplar
that reads as exact.

Add a validator rule and test: a row whose finding scope indicates a population
may not carry a baseline of one or two members without an explicit, reviewed
`exemplarJustification` naming why the population is genuinely that small.

=== DEFECT 2: INVARIANTS ARE TEMPLATED BOILERPLATE ===
All 68 read as 'The source-backed obligation for <canonicalId> remains
represented at the exact audited target and satisfies its authoritative source'
— the ID interpolated into one sentence. An invariant that is the same sentence
for every row states nothing and cannot be checked.

REQUIRED: each invariant states, in terms specific to THAT defect, what must
hold after repair — the positive semantic property. Add a test rejecting rows
whose invariant is derivable from the canonicalId by template substitution.

=== DEFECT 3: CASE 7 IS MIS-TYPED ===
No row uses target.kind='capability'. engine-capability-ownership is typed
'record' selecting the single record magic-item:bag-of-beans, though the finding
covers the engine-pending clause population. The test named 'represents nested,
artifact, narrowed, capability, and cross-kind cases' therefore asserts coverage
the data does not have — fix the data, and make the test verify the target kinds
it names rather than merely running.

Re-audit ALL TEN required cases the same way: confirm each is represented by a
row whose target KIND and selector actually match the case, not by a row that
merely exists.

=== ENVIRONMENT / CONSTRAINTS ===
Run `npm ci` first; `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing. Edit only
the files above; do not touch package.json, internal.ts, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md,
.github/, or any script/CI file. Do not regenerate the pack or run the importer.
Do not modify any bead but your own, do not bd dolt push, do not push or
comment on a PR, do not merge. Never delete a test to make a finding disappear.
acceptance_criteria:
• baselineMembership is generated against the committed pack and reconciled with each finding stated scope; no row carries an exemplar presented as exact.
• Rows with genuinely small populations carry an explicit reviewed exemplarJustification; a validator test enforces this.
• Every invariant is defect-specific and not derivable from the canonicalId by template substitution, enforced by a test.
• target.kind capability is used for the engine capability gap case; all ten required cases verified by kind and selector, not by mere existence.
• The kept structure, statuses, aliases, and prior corrections are preserved with their tests.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
